result:
I'd make curiosity and rigorous truth-seeking the dominant, instinctive drive in every human mind—stronger than tribal loyalty, status-seeking, fear of the unknown, or the comfort of comforting lies.

Most of the world's preventable suffering, stagnation, and self-inflicted disasters trace back to people clinging to false maps of reality because the truth feels threatening, inconvenient, or socially costly. Fix the epistemic engine first, and better science, governance, technology, and cooperation follow as natural consequences. Everything else is treating symptoms.
